intro: The Damned is an early task given to newly awakened Forsaken by Novice Elreth in the chapel of Deathknell. In exchange for the materials needed to fashion crude clothing and battlefield wraps, Elreth provides salvageable armor to protect fledgling undead from the perils surrounding the cemetery.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.

From the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... Hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. This armor should help you out.
Hopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...
